rationale: Independent PO review conducted for scrum-master REVIEW_REQUEST. After thorough code examination, I confirm the findings of the 14:00Z independent review: the delivery is functionally sound but contains a HIGH severity security issue (Redis password hardcoded in 5 source files) and MEDIUM test quality issues (tautological assertion on line 154, 'no external effects' hardcoded True without verification). The chain of validation was violated — the developer merged PR #701 without prior independent PO review. While the core scenario 1 test validates the full chain publish → relay v4.1 → launcher → COMPLETED, the security and quality issues require correction in a follow-up PR before final acceptance.

task_id_stable.evidence: test_scenario1_e2e.py:47 — task_id hardcoded 'task_scenario1_001', assertions verify persistence via task_key (line 126) and result_key (line 137). Protocol v1.0.0 enforces task_id in message schema (fleet_protocol.py:117).

events_received_to_completed.evidence: RECEIVED ✓ (queue length=1, line 85-89). ACCEPTED ✗ (tautological assertion on line 154 — 'relay.returncode is not None' is always True for any completed subprocess, even non-zero exit). STARTED not explicitly checked. COMPLETED ✓ (inbox state=COMPLETED verified on lines 114-122).

result_persisted.evidence: fleet_launcher.py:334 — result_key(task_id) SET with TTL 86400. Test line 137 verifies GET on result:<task_id> returns persisted result with state=COMPLETED.

no_external_effects.evidence: Hardcoded True on line 157/165 — no actual verification that task produces no git/file/network side effects. The task body is declarative but not programmatically enforced.

queue_consumed.evidence: Atomic RPOPLPUSH in relay_v4.1.py line 243 — removes from queue to processing atomically. ACK via LREM on line 255.

duration_under_5s.evidence: Scenario designed for fast execution (test config max_turns=10, run_budget=120).

observations.description: Redis password 'OTn1WGEUUNsLJDQ3xfokPcxVe75YgtbMdvoPKLzW' hardcoded in 5 source files — exposed in version control and PR diff. This is a credential leak.
observations.recommendation: Mandatory REDIS_PASS env var with no default fallback; if missing, fail immediately with clear error message. Remove all hardcoded password defaults. Migrate to secrets manager for production.

observations.description: Assertion 'relay.returncode is not None' is always True for any completed subprocess (even if exit code is non-zero). This tautology does not verify actual relay success.
observations.recommendation: Replace with 'relay.returncode == 0' to verify actual relay success. Consider also checking relay stderr for error indicators.

observations.description: Default REDIS_HOST=172.16.12.2 and REDIS_PASS='' hardcoded with silent fallback — could mask misconfiguration in production deployments.
observations.recommendation: Fail-fast on missing required config in production mode; remove silent defaults or require explicit opt-in for test mode.

observations.description: 'Sans effet externe': True hardcoded — no real assertion that task produces no git/file/network side effects.
observations.recommendation: Assert no git changes (git status --porcelain), no file writes outside test/tmp directories, no network calls outside Redis.

observations.description: RuntimeError references args.run_budget via closure — fragile coupling between run_task and argparse namespace.
observations.recommendation: Pass budget explicitly as parameter to run_task for cleaner separation.
